provisions.heading: Application of Australian Consumer Law text

status.source_statement: Currency start 25 Sep 2025; Currency end: Current (in force)

encoding: binary; application/pdf; stored byte-exact with no transformation, normalisation, re-serialisation, or correction
hash_convention: SHA-256 computed over the exact stored file bytes; binary file, no trailing-newline convention applied
notes: Whole-Act official consolidated PDF captured as a single shared fixture; sections 18 and 19 are recorded as pinpoints and derived to per-section text in the provisions/ subdirectory. Section 19 gives effect to the Australian Consumer Law text, being Schedule 2 to the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Commonwealth), as a law of Western Australia.
Recorded fixtures are a point-in-time snapshot for deterministic testing only. They are NOT a live legal-currency service and may not reflect amendments made after the retrieval timestamp.
Per-section exact-text extraction and deterministic validation are performed by scripts/derive_wa_provisions.py (ADR 0013).
The official host is www.legislation.wa.gov.au, a subdomain of legislation.wa.gov.au.
